units.source_text: 古歌云：“密叶丛林里，日光射进来”，因此荒僻的宇治山庄里也能看到春光。

en.t: An old poem says, "Into the dense-leaved grove, the sunlight streams," and so even in the desolate mountain villa at Uji, spring light could be seen.

units.source_text: 但二女公子只觉得像做梦一般，不知道这些日子如何度送。

en.t: But the second young lady felt only as if she were dreaming, and did not know how she had passed these days.

units.source_text: 年来她和姐姐两人情亲意洽，随着四时变易，晨夕共赏花香鸟语。

en.t: For years she and her elder sister had been deeply close, and as the seasons changed they enjoyed together, morning and evening, the fragrance of flowers and the songs of birds.

units.source_text: 有时闲吟戏咏，互相联句；有时共话浊世忧辛，以慰寂寥。

en.t: At times they idly chanted and playfully composed poems, linking verses with one another; at times they spoke together of the sorrows and hardships of this troubled world, comforting their loneliness.

units.source_text: 如今失去了姐姐，遇有可喜可悲之事，无人可以告语。

en.t: Now that she had lost her sister, whenever something joyful or sorrowful happened, there was no one to whom she could speak of it.

units.source_text: 万事只能闷在胸中，独自伤心。

en.t: She could only keep everything shut inside her heart and grieve alone.

units.source_text: 昔年丧父，固然抱恨终天；此次丧姐，似觉比那时更多悲恸。

en.t: When she had lost her father years before, she had of course carried a lifelong sorrow; but losing her sister this time seemed even more painful than that.

units.source_text: 思念无已，不知此后如何度日。

en.t: Her longing had no end, and she did not know how she would live from then on.

units.source_text: 因此一直心绪昏乱，连昼夜都不辨。

en.t: Because of this, her mind remained clouded and confused, until she could no longer even tell day from night.

units.source_text: 有一天，阿阇梨派人送信来，信中说道：“岁时更新，不知近况如何？

en.t: One day, the Ajari sent someone with a letter, in which he wrote, "The year has turned anew; I wonder how you are faring now?

units.source_text: 此间祈祷照常举行，曾不稍怠。

en.t: Here, the prayers are being performed as usual, without the slightest neglect.

units.source_text: 此次乃专为小姐一人祈求福德也。”

en.t: This time they are offered especially for you alone, my lady, to pray for your blessings and merit."

units.source_text: 随函送上蕨及问荆，装在一只精致的篮子里，

en.t: Together with the letter he sent bracken and horsetails, placed in a delicate basket,

units.source_text: 附言道：“此蕨与问荆乃诸童子为供养贫僧而采得者，

en.t: and added a note saying, "These bracken and horsetails were gathered by the acolytes as an offering to this poor monk,
and all are fresh, newly sprouted shoots."

units.source_text: 所附诗歌，故意写成字字分离，诗曰：

en.t: The poem enclosed with it was deliberately written with each character separated from the next, and it read:
